cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/search/message_champions.py shadow_frontier/catalog/ghost_catalog.tex shadow_frontier/catalog/ghost_catalog.pdf && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Message champions: the forced-continuation game, played and solved

search/message_champions.py: hunt messages (naive {1,2} spelling) whose
carry-cascade continuation survives long past the script. Results
added to the catalog interlude:
- dictionary champion 'bopped': 48 scripted letters + 36 forced
  (integer 1769681963780500439019); 'Bancroft' +36 after 64;
- best 2-char message (a + backtick): seed 4063723 (22 bits), 16
  script + 34 forced = 50 total, ratio 2.3 - a survival champion
  wearing a 2-char name;
- the law is exact: best-of-N wins log_{4/3}(N) forced letters
  (prediction 37/32 for N=44k/9025; measured 36/34). No magic words -
  the dictionary behaves like 44,000 random seeds, Borel-Cantelli
  paying at its stated rate. Greedy GHOST extension reaches only +21:
  greedy loses to global search as theory demands. All catalog claims
  machine-verified before commit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 3 --text "message_champions.py + catalog update: forced-continuation game. Dictionary champion 'bopped' (+36 forced after 48 script; integer 1769681963780500439019); best 2-char message (a + backtick) = 4063723 (22 bits): 16+34=50 letters, ratio 2.3 = champion in disguise; best-of-N law exact (log_{4/3} N: predicted 37/32, measured 36/34 for N=44k/9025); greedy GHOST tail only +21 (greedy < global, as expected). No magic words: dictionary = 44k random seeds; Borel-Cantelli at stated rate. Claims machine-verified." 2>&1 | tail -1 && ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
